## Purpose

## Validation

- [ ] `make validate` succeeds.
- [ ] The change was tested through `kwboot` before any NAND write.
- [ ] The log contains no MAC address, serial number, certificate, or `devinfo` dump.
- [ ] Support remains limited to the WRT1900ACS v2 Rev.A00, or a separate port was created.
- [ ] Documentation and the validation matrix are up to date.
- [ ] Documentation, comments, diagnostics, and user-facing messages are in English.
